title: A tech worker in China is laid off and replaced by AI. Is it legal? (NPR)
notes: NPR (top-tier), full article retrieved. Supports: Hangzhou Intermediate Court unlawful-dismissal ruling; Zhou QA supervisor, 300,000 yuan ($43,900) annual, 40% pay cut refused, won arbitration/district/appeal; court quote on 'impossible to continue the employment contract'; Beijing data-mapper case (2025) won arbitration — AI switch a 'business choice' not uncontrollable event, dismissal illegal; lawyer Wang Xuyang (Xinhua).
